task: Parse an AWS CloudWatch log entry and extract the timestamp, log level, and message using a regular expression
solution_criteria: The regex should correctly capture timestamp in ISO 8601 format, log level (INFO, ERROR, WARN, DEBUG), and the remaining message text. Should handle variations in spacing and log formats.

task: Write a Python function that takes an AWS S3 bucket name and returns True if it follows AWS naming conventions (lowercase, 3-63 characters, no consecutive hyphens)
solution_criteria: Function should validate S3 bucket naming rules: lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only; length between 3-63 characters; must not start or end with hyphen; must not contain consecutive hyphens. Should return boolean result.

task: Create a JSON configuration object for an AWS Lambda function that includes environment variables, timeout settings, memory allocation, and IAM role ARN
solution_criteria: JSON should be valid and include keys for FunctionName, Runtime, Handler, Role, Timeout, MemorySize, and Environment variables (with nested Variables object). Values should be realistic AWS resource identifiers.
